title: Basic Law of Governance
orig: النظام الأساسي للحكم
groups: All persons in the Kingdom; Art. 28 (state facilitates work) is framed for citizens; no general non-discrimination clause [wording to verify on BOE]

title: Labour Law
orig: نظام العمل
groups: Private-sector workers incl. non-Saudis. Art. 7(1)(c)-(d) excludes domestic workers and agricultural workers/private shepherds; separate regulations for them under Art. 7(2) [Art. 7 wording confirmed as quoted by HRSD, 2024; effect of the 2025 amendments (Royal Decree M/44) on Art. 7 not checked]

title: Implementing Regulations of the Labour Law
orig: اللائحة التنفيذية لنظام العمل
groups: Workers covered by the Labour Law (same exclusions)

title: Regulation of Domestic Workers and Similar Categories
orig: لائحة العمالة المنزلية ومن في حكمهم
groups: Domestic workers and similar (private drivers, guards, gardeners, cooks). REPLACED by the Domestic Workers Regulation, MD 40676 of 17/03/1445H (Umm Al-Qura 6 Oct 2023; in force one year after issue) - see separate row

title: Residence Regulations (Iqama Law)
orig: نظام الإقامة
groups: All foreign residents; legal basis of sponsorship (kafala) together with Labour Law rules

title: Labour Reform Initiative (Improvement of the Contractual Relationship) [tr]
orig: مبادرة تحسين العلاقة التعاقدية
groups: Expatriate workers under the Labor Law: job mobility, exit/re-entry and final exit without employer consent. Domestic workers not covered (they have a separate mobility regime: MD 212875/1443 and HRSD 2024 rules - see separate row)

title: Wage Protection System [tr]
orig: برنامج حماية الأجور
groups: Private-sector establishments, phased in by size. Domestic workers: salary transfer through Musaned-linked digital wallets made compulsory in phases - 1 Jul 2024 new arrivals; 1 Jan 2025 employers with 4+ workers; 1 Jul 2025 3+; 1 Oct 2025 2+; 1 Jan 2026 all domestic workers (HRSD FAQ)

title: Decision banning work under direct sunlight at midday [tr]
orig: قرار حظر العمل تحت أشعة الشمس
groups: Private-sector outdoor workers, 12:00–15:00, 15 June–15 September; some governorates exempt. GLMM page records the earlier 2010 decision (1 July–31 Aug)

title: Anti-Trafficking in Persons Law
orig: نظام مكافحة جرائم الاتجار بالأشخاص
groups: All persons

title: Social Insurance Law
orig: نظام التأمينات الاجتماعية
groups: In force 3 July 2024 for new entrants (earlier M/33 law still governs prior subscribers). Non-Saudis: occupational hazards branch only under M/33; M/273 wording for non-Saudis not verified. End-of-service gratuity for non-Saudis is under the Labour Law

title: Law of the Judiciary (establishes labor courts)
orig: نظام القضاء
groups: Labor courts hear Labour Law disputes (operating since 2018). Forum for domestic-worker disputes not verified

title: Regulation of Recruitment Companies and Offices [tr]
orig: لائحة شركات ومكاتب الاستقدام
groups: Licensed recruitment companies and offices, incl. domestic-worker recruitment

title: Ministerial decision raising the minimum wage for Saudis [tr]
orig: قرار رفع الحد الأدنى لأجور السعوديين
groups: Saudi nationals only (SAR 4,000 for Nitaqat counting); no minimum wage for non-Saudis

title: Domestic Workers and Those in Their Position Regulation
orig: لائحة العمالة المنزلية ومن في حكمها
groups: Domestic workers (14 occupations incl. home farmer, home guard, private driver). Replaces CoM Decision 310/1434; in force one year after issue (c. Oct 2024). Min. age 21 (Art. 6); max 10 h/day, 8 h continuous rest (Art. 10); 1 weekly rest day (Art. 11); 30 days leave per 2 years (Art. 12); sick leave 15 full + 15 half pay (Art. 13); employer bears recruitment costs, no passport retention (Art. 15); end-of-service 1 month per 4 years (Art. 22); worker may end contract with rights for abuse/breach (Art. 27); fines up to SAR 20,000 (Art. 29). Silent on freedom of association

title: Ministerial decision on transfer of domestic workers to another employer without the employer's consent
orig: قرار نقل خدمات العمالة المنزلية دون موافقة صاحب العمل
groups: Domestic workers. 12 cases for transfer without consent (e.g. 3 unpaid wages, no residence permit within 30 days, hiring out, dangerous work, abuse, employer stalling complaint or absent, contract ended in probation); final exit at end of contract. Implemented by HRSD rules (2024), which still cite the 2013 regulation. Updates an earlier decision (number not confirmed)

title: Regulation for Agricultural Workers, Private Shepherds and Similar
orig: لائحة عمال الزراعة والرعاة الخاصون ومن في حكمهم
groups: Agricultural workers and private shepherds excluded from the Labour Law (Art. 7(1)(d)). Regulation existence confirmed on HRSD (gcc-check SA2, 2026-10-31); date and content not extracted

title: Constitution of the United Arab Emirates
orig: دستور دولة الإمارات العربية المتحدة
groups: Art. 25 equality applies to citizens; Art. 34 prohibits forced labor (all persons); Art. 40 foreigners enjoy rights under international agreements

title: Federal Decree-Law on the Regulation of Labour Relations
orig: مرسوم بقانون اتحادي بشأن تنظيم علاقات العمل
groups: Private sector incl. free zones (DIFC/ADGM have their own laws). Excludes domestic workers, federal and local government employees, armed forces and police. Coverage of agricultural workers (excluded under the 1980 law) not verified

title: Executive Regulations of the Labour Relations Decree-Law
orig: اللائحة التنفيذية لقانون تنظيم علاقات العمل
groups: Same scope as Federal Decree-Law 33/2021

title: Federal Decree-Law Concerning Domestic Workers
orig: مرسوم بقانون اتحادي بشأن عمال الخدمة المساعدة
groups: Domestic workers in the occupations listed in the executive regulations (incl. farmer, gardener, household shepherd, horse groomer, falcon tamer per MOHRE); replaced Federal Law 10/2017. Min. age 18 (Art. 4(3)(H)); agencies may not charge workers (Art. 5(2)); worker keeps ID documents (Art. 11(11)); transfer right (Art. 21); disputes MOHRE/court, no court fees (Arts 23, 26). Gratuity: Art. 22 leaves the formula to the Cabinet - none found in FDL 9/2022 or CR 106/2022 (checked 2026-11-11). Portal lists 2 amendments incl. FDL 21/2023 (Art. 23)

title: Executive Regulations of the Domestic Workers Decree-Law
orig: اللائحة التنفيذية لقانون عمال الخدمة المساعدة
groups: Domestic workers; rest periods, weekly day off, employer violations and fines; transfer and refund of recruitment costs (Art. 6); cases where the worker may leave work, incl. immediately after assault (Art. 10). No gratuity formula

title: Federal Decree-Law on Entry and Residence of Foreigners
orig: مرسوم بقانون اتحادي بشأن دخول وإقامة الأجانب
groups: All foreigners; replaced Federal Law 6/1973. Residence still tied to an employer/sponsor except for self-sponsored categories

title: Ministerial Resolution on the Wage Protection System
orig: قرار وزاري بشأن نظام حماية الأجور

title: Ministerial Decree regarding the determination of midday working hours
orig: قرار وزاري بشأن تحديد ساعات العمل وقت الظهيرة
groups: Outdoor workers, 12:30–15:00 from 15 June to 15 September; reissued each year by MOHRE resolution. Exemptions for continuous-process work

title: Federal Law on Combating Human Trafficking Crimes
orig: قانون اتحادي في شأن مكافحة جرائم الاتجار بالبشر
groups: All persons (amended by Federal Law 1/2015 and Federal Decree-Law 24/2023)

title: Federal Decree-Law on Unemployment Insurance
orig: مرسوم بقانون اتحادي بشأن التأمين ضد التعطل عن العمل
groups: Private-sector and federal government employees incl. non-nationals. Excludes domestic workers, investors, temporary workers, under-18s and retirees [per law; to verify]

title: Ministerial Resolution on labor complaints and disputes (as amended)
orig: قرار وزاري بشأن الشكاوى والمنازعات العمالية
groups: Workers under Federal Decree-Law 33/2021; MOHRE may decide claims up to AED 50,000 (Federal Decree-Law 20/2023) [to verify]

title: Ministerial Resolution licensing and regulating private employment/recruitment agencies
orig: قرار وزاري بشأن ترخيص وتنظيم وكالات التوظيف

title: Ministerial Resolution licensing and regulating domestic workers recruitment offices
orig: قرار وزاري بشأن ترخيص وتنظيم مكاتب استقدام عمال الخدمة المساعدة
groups: Domestic-worker recruitment offices (incl. Tadbeer centers)

title: Permanent Constitution of the State of Qatar
orig: الدستور الدائم لدولة قطر
groups: Art. 35 equality before the law for all persons; Art. 52 protects lawful residents; Art. 30 labor relations

title: Labour Law
orig: قانون العمل
groups: Private-sector workers. Art. 3 excludes domestic workers (Law 15/2017), workers in agriculture and grazing, government and public-corporation employees, and some others. Amended by Laws 1/2015, 13/2017, 18/2020

title: Law on Domestic Workers
orig: قانون العمالة المنزلية
groups: Domestic workers (drivers, nannies, cooks, gardeners and similar)

title: Law regulating the Entry, Exit and Residence of Expatriates
orig: قانون تنظيم دخول وخروج الوافدين وإقامتهم
groups: All expatriates; exit permits abolished by Law 13/2018 (and for domestic workers in 2019); employer NOC for job change removed in 2020 (Law 19/2020)

title: Ministerial Decision issuing the Regulations of the Wage Protection System
orig: قرار وزاري بإصدار لائحة نظام حماية الأجور
groups: Workers subject to the Labour Law (not domestic workers)

title: Law on the Minimum Wage for Workers and Domestic Workers
orig: قانون بتحديد الحد الأدنى لأجور العمال والمستخدمين في المنازل
groups: All workers incl. domestic workers: QAR 1,000 basic plus food and housing allowances (Ministerial Decision 25/2020)

title: Ministerial Decision on measures to prevent heat stress
orig: قرار وزاري بشأن الاحتياطات اللازمة لوقاية العمال من الإجهاد الحراري
groups: Outdoor workers: ban 10:00–15:30 from 1 June to 15 September and full stop above WBGT 32.1°C. GLMM page covers the earlier 2020 measures

title: Law on Combating Trafficking in Human Beings
orig: قانون مكافحة الاتجار بالبشر
groups: All persons

title: Law establishing the Workers' Support and Insurance Fund
orig: قانون بإنشاء صندوق دعم وتأمين العمال
groups: Workers with unpaid wages after a dispute-committee ruling, incl. domestic workers [coverage of domestic workers to verify]

title: Cabinet Resolution establishing the Labour Dispute Resolution Committees
orig: قرار مجلس الوزراء بتشكيل لجان فض المنازعات العمالية

title: Ministerial Decision on licenses to recruit foreign workers for others
orig: قرار وزاري بشأن شروط وإجراءات الترخيص باستقدام العمال من الخارج لحساب الغير
groups: Recruitment offices; whether later rules replaced it not verified

orig: دستور دولة الكويت

orig: قانون في شأن مكافحة الاتجار بالأشخاص وتهريب المهاجرين

orig: قرار حظر العمل في الأماكن المكشوفة وقت الظهيرة

title: Wage protection rules (PAM) [tr]
orig: نظام حماية الأجور

Art. 23(C): no one may take money or any benefit from a worker for a work permit, employment or keeping the job; Art. 36: prison 3 months-1 year and/or BD 1,000-2,000, domestic-worker cases aggravating. Decree-Law 12/2024 amended Art. 40

orig: قانون الأجانب (الهجرة والإقامة)

orig: قرار بشأن تنظيم تصاريح عمل عمال المنازل ومن في حكمهم
groups: Domestic workers (Art. 2: incl. planter, home guard, babysitter, driver, cook, when employed not for profit); no permit if employer failed to fulfil a servant's rights or mistreated them (Art. 3). A tripartite standard contract followed in 2017 (not located)
